about_the_game:
Army Troop Remastered brings the classic Army Troop to life with immersive 4K graphics and enhanced realism. This remastered version offers a complete overhaul, with every sound, music, effect, UI, and 3D model redesigned for a more dynamic experience, featuring 4K textures. Jump into epic WW2 online PvP combat, selecting from a variety of soldiers (Infantry, Recon, Tank Crew, Paratrooper, and more) and a wide array of weapons like Assault Rifles, SMGs, Snipers, and LMGs. Customize your class with perks, weapon skins, and accessories like sight scopes and silencers to suit your playstyle.

Dive into intense online PvP combat and battle players from around the world across a variety of exciting WW2 maps. Play alongside or against your friends in both online and private matches, including team deathmatch and free-for-all modes.

The game features our best AI bot system, where bots react almost like real players, ensuring every match is filled with challenging 5v5 action—even when no players are online, as well as a bots-only mode, allowing you to play exclusively with bots and still progress with upgrades.

New content, including maps, characters, weapons, skins, perks, accessories, and game modes, is regularly added.

With improved optimization and matchmaking, Army Troop Remastered provides the ultimate WW2 FPS experience for both newcomers and veterans.
